name: @apelles/brand
description: Apelles brand kits (D-416): the kit schema (colours, type, logos, motion style, captions, a grade look, sound, references), the WCAG contrast check, the library and project-snapshot store over the `chroma_brand_*` commands, the per-tab applier registry (one undo step per tab), the `brand_*` op registry, and (subpath `./ui`) the Brand panel. Below the tabs: it never imports one; each tab registers its own applier.
